 Calvin Harris set to return to Seattle in 2027
 By
 Alan K 
 on
 October 19, 2026 
 Recently a sign was spotted in downtown Seattle teasing a potential Calvin Harris return to the Emerald City! Similar signs were spotted across North America, in Chicago, Houston, Oakland, Philadelphia, New York City, and Vancouver BC. Now, it’s officially confirmed that Calvin Harris is embarking on a headline North American tour in spring of 2027!
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by Calvin Harris (@calvinharris) 
 Calvin Harris is slated to return to Seattle on May 13, 2027 at Climate Pledge Arena. The last time Calvin Harris performed in Seattle was for FreakNight back in 2013. We were speculating that he would have to play at a large venue in WA state, like the Gorge, Gas Works, or Tacoma Dome. Many other high profile names have taken over Climate Pledge in recent memory, like Kygo, Swedish House Mafia, and Kaytranada.
 Recently we had another legend make a trip back to the PNWin Skrillex, who took over Gas Works Park alongside Porter Robinson, Ninajirachi, Underscores, and others for a once in a lifetime event. We expect the magnitude of a Calvin Harris show in Seattle to be comparable, so get ready for tickets to sell out instantly.
 As we’re putting together this article, Calvin Harris just finished performing in Indio, CA at the inaugural Head Trip Festival. Day 1 was cut short due to thunderstorms, but he was added to the Day 2 lineup before Swedish House Mafia. Also, huge shoutout to Apple Music for video streaming the festival for free!
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by HEAD TRIP (@headtripindio) 
 Artist presale starts Tuesday, October 20 at calvinharris.com. General on sale will be on Thursday, October 22, so sign up now and get ready to secure your tickets!
